policy: No unpinned auto-updates. Downloaded instructions are not executed during installation. Superseded same-purpose packages and incomplete stubs are recoverably archived.

runtime_notes.semantic_search: Off by default; lexical multilingual ranking does not download or load GPU models.
runtime_notes.context7: Official HTTPS documentation queries only; secrets are scrubbed before transmission.
runtime_notes.markitdown: Microsoft 0.1.8, local processing; explicitly trusted Windows process, not an OS sandbox.
runtime_notes.agent-os: Disabled export-only facade to avoid duplicating WISE native tools.
